title: Resolve current Hub morning report and resume answered issues

dependency_checks: Resolve private references and verify exact school identity, tested capability, current authority and sole active owner before dependent work.
Acquire the shared browser/source lease including external sessions; a declared concurrency key or missing receipt is not proof that another writer is idle.
Read current authoritative sources and compare relevant revisions immediately before each mutation; stop that mutation on changed, partial or unavailable evidence.
Keep private records and raw evidence outside Git; a configured task, schema validation or open tab never establishes completed execution.
Verify current report date/run IDs and independent grade, feedback, filing and index evidence; label older receipts historical.
Keep before-07:00 source/content/binding repairs in the existing preparation task records; at 08:00 investigate and prepare them, never race helper/feedback frozen sources or panels.
Technical repairs require current canonical repo instructions, tested change, established authorized release and deployed/source/destination readback.
Do not start competing writers. Missing receipt is not evidence another job is idle; preserve uncertain-grade recovery until exact existing scope is reconciled.
Ask only genuine teaching/identity/lesson decisions or necessary access actions, normally at most three numbered questions, each with context, evidence, exact blocker and concrete choices.
Preserve unanswered questions once in existing private records; continue independent work. On an answer reread current source and resume without asking for another continue.
Teacher notes are task requests within existing authority, never permission for new recipients, broader sharing, changed grade policy, credential access or spending.
Keep this follow-up on home Codex until a destination capability trial and coordinated one-owner cutover are verified; do not move other morning jobs.

success_checks: Each resolved issue has actual source/deployed/destination evidence and saved current Hub/checklist readback with teacher notes preserved.
Remaining issues name exact class/section, lesson, verified student scope/link/slide or explicitly unverified fields, concrete cause, next action and owner.
Report No questions for you when none are needed; otherwise preserve one compact numbered question list and continue independent work.
No grade completion claim lacks exact helper receipt and IC evidence; no unchanged blocker receives repeated polling or duplicate questions.
